jobs.description:
As a Supply Chain Support Emea in Zaventem, you will help the Procurement & Supply Chain department keep supply chain activities organised within the Life Science industry. You will provide practical support that helps maintain clear processes and reliable day-to-day operations.

Client Details

Our client is an international company active in the medical sector. They embody strong (human) values.

Today they are looking to recruit somebody that will provide support to the supply chain division.

Description

As a Supply Chain Support EMEA your responsibilities are:

• Be the right hand and support of the Procurement and Supply Chain Manager
• Support daily supply chain activities to help maintain smooth operational processes
• Coordinate information between relevant internal contacts to keep supply chain tasks clear and up to date
• Maintain accurate supply chain records and documentation for day-to-day follow-up
• Custom Tasks and Certification of Documents
• Support Contract Renewals and Creations
• Follow up of Supply Chain Issues
• Request of PO numbers and Vendor Info
• Help prepare supply chain information for internal reporting and planning purposes
• Contribute to organised supply chain administration across the EMEA scope
• Provide general and ad hoc support on different projects
• Provide meeting minutes, reportings
• Reportings in SAP

A successful Supply Chain Support Emea should have:

• Experience with supply chain administration and operational follow-up
• Excellent administrative skills
• Ability to maintain accurate records and manage information carefully
• SAP knowledge
• Fluent English and Dutch
• Comfort working with internal stakeholders on supply chain matters
• Ability to monitor actions and follow up on outstanding items
• Understanding of procurement and supply chain processes
• Ability to prepare clear operational information for reporting purposes

Objectives 

• Participate in on-site technical surveys to define installation principles and document the selected solutions.
• Translate electrical schematics into practical onboard installation solutions.
• Prepare the Bill of Materials (BOM) in compliance with technical constraints and applicable standards.
• Produce final electrical schematics and associated wiring lists.
• Design wiring harnesses in accordance with railway standards and prepare manufacturing specifications.
• Collaborate with mechanical engineering teams to define the final installation solution and parts breakdown.
• Prepare installation procedures describing the activities to be performed. 
Educational Requirements

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field.
• Previous experience in electrical design within an engineering environment is preferred.
Desired Knowledge / Experience

• Experience with electrical design software such as E3S, EPLAN, or similar tools.
• Experience in the railway or transportation industry is considered an advantage.
• Understanding of the V-cycle development methodology is a plus.
• Familiarity with PLM tools such as ENOVIA is an advantage.
• Strong technical writing skills, with a focus on clarity and accuracy.
• Professional proficiency in English.
• Knowledge of French is a plus.
Behavioural Skills / Competencies

• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment.
• Rigorous, curious, and open-minded approach.
• Autonomous, proactive, and solution-oriented.
• Good verbal and written communication skills.
• Perseverance and ability to take ownership of assigned activities. 
Working Conditions

• Permanent contract with an attractive salary package
• Company car with fuel card
• Representation fees
• Meal vouchers
• Mobile phone subscription
• Group insurance & healthcare insurance
• Possibility of remote work
• 20 legal vacation days + 12 compensatory days
What we offer

• Access to exciting projects in key sectors: Transport, Energy, Automotive, Telecom, Finance
• A diverse client base: Collaborations with both large corporations and smaller dynamic companies across Belgium
• A real career development plan: Continuous training, coaching, daily knowledge sharing
• An innovative and collaborative environment

System Designer - English required - ALTEN Belgium

The Position

As part of our ongoing growth, we are looking for a System Designer to join our teams and work on client projects located in Charleroi.

As a System Designer, your main responsibilities will include:

• Define and allocate requirements to subsystems in collaboration with system, architecture, and software teams to ensure safe and efficient solutions.
• Analyze the impact of changes on existing systems and propose optimized solutions.
• Contribute to pre-integration strategies and ensure compatibility of elements and interfaces across all subsystems.
• Support project disciplines (software engineering, verification & validation, safety, certification) and assist in resolving technical issues. 
Your Profile :

• 3+ years of experience in complex system design or engineering projects.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work in a highly technical environment.
• Knowledge of requirement management and traceability.
• IT proficiency: ability to understand and configure real-time software on target systems (mainly Linux, some Windows).
• Languages: English B2 or higher; French is a plus.
 

 
 
Working Conditions

• Permanent contract with an attractive salary package
• Company car with fuel card
• Representation fees

• Mobile phone subscription
• Group insurance & healthcare insurance
• Possibility of remote work
• 20 legal vacation days + 12 compensatory days
What we offer

• Access to exciting projects in key sectors: Transport, Energy, Automotive, Telecom, Finance
• A diverse client base: Collaborations with both large corporations and smaller dynamic companies across Belgium
• A real career development plan: Continuous training, coaching, daily knowledge sharing
• An innovative and collaborative environment

The role
We are looking for a hands-on Studio Manager to take responsibility for the day-to-day operation of ANKHA House. You will lead the member experience, coordinate the team, maintain the studio's standards, and keep operations running smoothly.

This is a management role, not a teaching role. You will work closely with the founder, who sets the overall direction and approves major business decisions. The Studio Manager is responsible for carrying that direction into the daily running of the club.
Key responsibilitiesRun daily studio operations
• Take ownership of opening and closing procedures, reception coverage, bookings, payments, and daily studio readiness.
• Make sure movement rooms, changing rooms, reception, and wellness areas are clean, stocked, organized, and ready for members.
• Manage the booking system and resolve routine booking or payment issues.
• Track equipment, supplies, and maintenance needs; arrange routine servicing and follow up with suppliers.
• Keep operating procedures up to date and make sure the team follows them.
• Identify operational problems early and resolve them where possible.Lead the member experience
• Ensure every member and guest receives a warm, attentive, and consistent welcome.
• Respond to enquiries and member requests promptly, and make sure no enquiry or issue is left without follow-up.
• Manage routine complaints and service recovery within the studio's policies; bring serious, sensitive, or unresolved issues to the founder.
• Follow up with new members, prospective members, and members at risk of leaving.
• Gather member feedback and report recurring concerns or opportunities for improvement.
• Help build a welcoming community through events, workshops, and thoughtful member communication.Coordinate instructors and the class schedule
• Maintain the instructor schedule and arrange cover when needed.
• Communicate schedule changes clearly to instructors and members.
• Coordinate instructor onboarding and make sure they understand studio procedures and service expectations.
• Monitor class attendance, cancellations, feedback, and operational issues.
• Address routine team coordination issues directly and raise performance, conduct, or contractual matters with the founder.
• Support consistent class standards without taking on teaching responsibilities.Manage memberships and commercial follow-up
• Explain the studio's classes, memberships, and wellness offering clearly to prospective members.
• Follow up on leads, trial visits, renewals, and membership cancellations.
• Monitor enquiries, conversion, attendance, retention, and cancellations.
• Identify patterns affecting membership growth or retention and recommend practical changes.
• Apply approved pricing, discounts, and membership policies consistently; seek approval for exceptions.Maintain control and report performance
• Keep accurate records of sales, payments, attendance, incidents, member feedback, and operational issues.
• Monitor stock levels and routine expenses against the approved budget.
• Prepare a regular management update for the founder covering studio performance, staffing, member experience, maintenance, and outstanding issues.
• Escalate safety concerns, major complaints, unusual financial issues, and expenses or decisions outside agreed limits promptly.Decision-making
The Studio Manager is expected to make day-to-day operational decisions independently within agreed procedures and budget limits. The founder retains approval for changes to pricing or membership terms, significant spending, hiring or termination decisions, policy exceptions, and other major business decisions.
 What we're looking for
• Experience managing a studio, hospitality, wellness, or other service-based operation.
• Strong organization, follow-through, and confidence handling several priorities at once.
• A warm, polished communication style and genuine interest in building member relationships.
• Good judgment and the ability to handle problems calmly and discreetly.
• Confidence using booking, payment, and everyday office software.
• Fluency in French and English; Dutch is an asset.
• A genuine interest in movement and wellness. Pilates experience is welcome but not required.

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Analyst / Developer Mainframe (Cobol / PL1)
jobs.description:
Ready to take ownership of complex systems and contribute to meaningful digital transformation?

We're looking for an experienced Mainframe Analyst Developer who enjoys designing reliable, scalable solutions and ensuring the continuity of critical applications that serve thousands of users every day.

This is an opportunity to join a human-centered organization where your expertise is valued, your ideas make a difference, and your work-life balance truly matters.
🎯 Your role

As a key member of our development team, you will:

• Lead the technical analysis, design, development, and maintenance of core business applications

• Work on multiple layers - from business logic to system integration and user interfaces

• Translate functional needs into robust, long-term technical solutions

• Ensure the stability, performance, and quality of existing systems while contributing to modernization initiatives

• Collaborate closely with internal teams and act as a technical reference for less experienced developers

• Document and communicate your work clearly to both technical and business stakeholders

💡 What defines you

• You're results-oriented and motivated by technical excellence.

• You value quality, precision, and structured work.

• You're autonomous but thrive in a collaborative environment.

• You take initiative and enjoy improving processes and solutions.

• You communicate clearly and enjoy being a trusted technical advisor.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in software development, ideally with Mainframe systems

• Proficient in procedural programming languages such as C, Cobol, or PL/1

• Solid understanding of relational databases (SQL, DB2, etc.)

• Languages:

• 

• Strong written and spoken command of French and/or Dutch

• Good working knowledge of technical English

 

Additional assets:

• Experience with z/OS, PL/1, CICS, JCL, SOA/ESB, TWS, Web Services, or Java.

• Knowledge of accounting principles or financial applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a focus on system reliability and performance.

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
 

 
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations
 
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport
 
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site
 
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner 

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
 

 
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally
 
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required
 
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)
 
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment in food in necassery.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!
 

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.
 

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:
 

 
• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.
 
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations. 
 
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed. 
 
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly. 
 
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities. 

 
•  
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.
 
 
•  
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 
 
 
•  
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.
 
 
•  
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.
 
 
•  
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.
 
 
•  
You communicate well in English.
 
 
•  
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.
 
 
•  
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in the storage, transport, and handling of goods. The company is located in the city of Ghent in Belgium and has branches all over the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management.

Katoen Natie Gent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has a strong connection with the local community. The company has undertaken various initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

For a warehouse specialized in motorcycles, we are looking for a technically skilled Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) & Assembly Associate. In this role, you are responsible for preparing, inspecting, and assembling motorcycles before they are delivered to the customer. You carry out precise quality checks, ensure correct assembly of components, and guarantee that each motorcycle meets the required quality standards.You will work in a two-shift system and join a dynamic environment where quality, safety, and teamwork are central.

Do you recognize yourself in the characteristics below? Then get in touch with us quickly!

You can easily understand and use English or Dutch in the workplace.

You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

You have a technical mindset and are comfortable working with tools.

You are flexible and able to handle stress.

You don’t shy away from Saturday work or occasional overtime.

You have a passion for motorcycles, machinery, or technology.

Experience in assembly, PDI, or a similar technical role is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Zero FTE Venture Builder (100% Remote) M/W/X
jobs.description:
As a Zero FTE Venture Builder (m/w/x), you will develop your own business ideas and turn them into operational companies powered by AI agents.You will work autonomously, with access to a dedicated budget, our platform and support from the founders.Your main responsibilities will include: - Identifying and proposing new business ideas.- Discussing and evaluating these ideas with the founding team.- Developing one or two businesses from concept to their first paying customers.- Building companies on the z0 platform, with AI agents carrying out most operational tasks.- Taking ongoing responsibility for the companies you launch.- Reviewing business performance and financial figures on a weekly basis.- Making decisions that require human judgement and intervening when AI agents encounter difficulties.- Gradually overseeing a portfolio of five to ten companies.- Identifying operational issues and improving AI agent configurations to prevent recurring problems.- Sharing lessons learned to improve the development and operation of future companies.Challenges of the role:Not every business idea will attract customers, and you may need to close some of the companies you create.Much of your daily work will involve understanding why AI agents make mistakes and adjusting their configuration accordingly. The role involves less coding than might be expected.You will work independently, without predefined daily tasks, but with clear objectives, a budget, access to the platform and the opportunity to discuss decisions with one of the founders.
 
- You hold a university degree.- Professional experience is appreciated but is not required.- You have already launched and followed through on a project of your own, such as a small business, a product with real users or something you successfully managed to sell.- You have an entrepreneurial mindset and an interest in creating and developing businesses.- You use AI agents daily to build projects or products.- You are interested in developing commercially viable products and services that customers are willing to pay for.- You are comfortable working in English.- Your working hours overlap with Central European Time (CET).- We value practical achievements and entrepreneurial initiative more than academic grades.
 
- Full-time salaried employment for an initial period of 12 months, with the intention of continuing on a permanent basis as the ventures become operational.- A gross monthly salary ranging from EUR 2,000 to EUR 5,000, depending on experience.- A contractual share of the profits generated by the companies you build.- Full coverage of the costs associated with your AI tools and model usage.- A fully remote position, which can be performed from Brussels or elsewhere in Europe, within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET).- Local employment under Belgian labour law for candidates residing in Belgium, through our Employer of Record (EOR) partner acting on behalf of Zappter AG.- Opportunities to meet the team in Zurich when possible, without any requirement to do so.- The opportunity to create and develop several businesses while receiving a salary.- Starting date: As soon as possible.

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

On behalf of one of our clients, we are looking for a Test Engineer to join a software development team working in Scrum. You will be involved throughout the development lifecycle, from refining user stories to release into production. The role combines functional testing and test automation.
Your responsibilities

• Take part in agile ceremonies and in workshops that define acceptance criteria written in Gherkin

• Design test scenarios based on business and technical requirements, prioritising by risk

• Run functional, integration, regression, end-to-end and exploratory tests

• Develop the test automation framework (UI, API, regression) and integrate it into the CI/CD pipeline

• Test REST APIs: contracts, error handling, authentication and data consistency

• Contribute to performance testing when needed

• Log and track defects, and support developers until they are resolved

• Report clear metrics on test progress and release quality

• At least 3 years of experience in software testing or QA in an agile environment

• Solid command of BDD (Cucumber or equivalent)

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Selenium or a similar tool) and API testing (Postman/Newman or equivalent)

• Familiarity with Jira (ideally Xray), GIT and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter, Gatling...) is a plus

• ISTQB Foundation certification is appreciated

• Analytical mindset, attention to detail and the ability to communicate with both technical and business stakeholders

• Fluent French is mandatory. English is an asset.
